observation.new_content:
resources:
  jobs:
    consumer_order_items_workflow:
      name: consumer_order_items_workflow
      trigger:
        pause_status: UNPAUSED
        file_arrival:
          url: /Volumes/${var.catalog}/${var.pipeline_schema}/${var.volume}/consumer_order_items/
      tasks:
        - task_key: bronze
          pipeline_task:
            pipeline_id: ${resources.pipelines.consumer_order_items_bronze_pipeline.id}
        - task_key: silver
          depends_on:
            - task_key: bronze
          pipeline_task:
            pipeline_id: ${resources.pipelines.consumer_order_items_silver_pipeline.id}
      queue:
        enabled: true
